items.text: Household scale: commons-elohim composes a remembered-week stream from family-chosen patterns (care given, sleep lost), one-sentence non-pushy right-nav witness, no notifications
Household scale: member ring with household-only standing rings computed from a household-authored lamad-attested care rubric; standing-visible-only-when-active profile honored
Household scale: care acknowledgment flows a tiny REA shefa event into the care-economy ledger; cross-hub elohim-to-elohim quiet conversation (Gertrude check-in) gated by recovery-share relationship

Congregation scale: plural-stewardship (4 elders, no upward institutional parent); versioned rubric EPR signed by elders + ratified by congregational consent; Bloom's-curve standing specific to the congregation
Congregation scale: friction-gradient limitarianism notices elder accumulation and writes a gentle line into elders' shared view (lean-toward-one-voice prompt)

Life-group scale: sub-Qahal nesting first-class; rubric inherits from parent congregation + small local customization anchored upward; standing partially derived from parent-congregation standing (hard rule)

Life-group scale: prayers carried as cryptographically signed group attestations (we-held-this-together), encrypted to the group, not published/searched; cohesion-threshold witness from commons-elohim
Life-group scale: friction-gradient hosting-rotation prompt (hosted 23 of 24 Tuesdays -> invite another household)

Federation scale: wisdom-commons federation Qahal as peer-Qahal (no institutional parent, no authority to bind/discipline); shared rubric TEMPLATE each congregation may adopt/adapt/decline; upward anchor by choice only
Federation scale: REA wisdom-exchange events (offered not commanded); member ring of congregations-not-individuals with federation-template standing

Federation scale: concern surface (structured object) + voluntary peer-council convening (no court, no binding authority) producing a witness (peer testimony) + REA reconciliation event; commons-elohim witnesses openly per federation agreement
Federation scale: friction-gradient ensures no single elder authored the council witness, rubric honored, no congregation gained authority over another (horizontal-not-down)
Cross-scale invariant: one Qahal primitive renders differently because rubric/standing/reach/commons-elohim-vantage shift with the collective; holons compose without flattening
